headline: For operators whose agents share consequential state.
lede: Neotoma fits when continuity crosses tools and sessions, but building custom state infrastructure would be a distraction.

items.label: Good fit
items.title: Several agents touch the same work
items.body: You already run more than one AI tool and need them to act on the same current facts and decisions.

items.label: Good fit
items.title: You want to own the record
items.body: Local control, inspectable history, and portable data matter more than a black-box memory feature.

items.label: Not the job
items.title: You only need better recall inside one chat
items.body: If retrieving a previous sentence solves the problem, a lighter memory tool is the better choice.
